text:
Ravi: FYI seeing 3x OOMs in d2-prod during the 18:30 spike, host=cuda-host-11. Attachting minimal logs, looks like a workspace grow on an atypical kernel path. :eyes:
runtime-bot: alert: gpu_oom_detected pool=d2-prod host=cuda-host-11 count=3 window=5m
Katherine: can you paste the trace snippet? notable whether kvcache grew or batch size spiked
Ravi: log excerpt:
```
[18:30:12] allocate workspace 512MB -> requested 768MB
[18:30:12] kernel=attn_v2_optized selected -> mem_delta +240MB
[18:30:12] KVCache entries=42 -> prefetch +128MB
[18:30:13] OOM on cudaMalloc at 0x7f..
```
Diego: could be kernel selector biased to high-throughput kernels that are memory heavy for long seqs. Also KV prefetch heuristics kicked in - TTL bump from 300->900s on that pool last week?
Megan: suggest triage steps: 1) temp route heavy seqs to quantized-cpu fallback, 2) reduce kvcache ttl for d2-prod to 120s, 3) lower allocator soft_reserve to 0.12 for the host pool, 4) enable transient-buffer-reclaim for attn_v2_optized.
Katherine: add small-batch fallback: if request_seq_len > 2048 or expected_output > 2k tokens then route to small-batch kernel (kernel_selector hint mem-frugal). Also set circuit breaker to reject > 8k token requests with 429 and instructions to retry with trimmed prompt.
Ravi: quick config snippets I used for a canary patch (kubectl patch style):
```
PATCH /api/v1/pools/d2-prod/config
{
  "allocator": { "soft_reserve": 0.12, "workspace_limit_mb": 640 },
  "kvcache": { "ttl_sec": 120, "max_prefetch_entries": 16 },
  "routing": { "seq_len_threshold": 2048, "kernel_hint": "mem-frugal" },
  "circuit_breaker": { "max_request_tokens": 8000, "action": "reject" }
}
```
Diego: +1 on workspace_limit to prevent runaway growth. For attn_v2_optized we should flip buffer_reuse=false as a short-term mitigation; it reduces peak but costs a bit more allocations.
Megan: telemetry queries to validate after deploy:
- tokens_by_seq_len in last 30m
- host_mem_margin percentiles (p5,p25,p50,p90)
- kernel_selection_rate by kernel id
- kvcache_evictions per minute
Run: `SELECT seq_len, count(*) FROM traces WHERE host='cuda-host-11' AND ts>now()-30m GROUP BY seq_len`
Ravi: doing a canary now on one host with the above patch. Will also add a temporary route to cpu-quantize for requests with prompt tag `heavy-ctx`.
Katherine: alert policy tweak: generate page if host_mem_margin p5 < 0.08 for two consecutive minutes. That gives oncall earlier heads-up.
Megan: long term ideas (for RFC): smarter kernel scoring that penalizes transient kvcache + workspace combos, proactive preflight that computes expected memory delta before kernel selection, and streaming kvcache eviction that prefers older sessions.
Diego: for immediate incident, timeline: T+0: apply canary patch to host-11; T+3m: monitor host_mem_margin and evictions; T+10m: if still OOMs, rollback kernel to previous version and open full incident.
Ravi: update: canary applied, host_mem_margin p5 went 0.06 -> 0.18 in 2m, no new OOMs so far. Leaving buffer_reuse disabled for 20m then re-evaluate. :thumbsup:
Megan: thanks — please paste final diff and telemetry check when stable so I can prep postmortem notes and follow-up action items. :memo:
